brand_identity.name: collectFlow

brand_identity.subheadline: collectFlow helps Indian businesses and modern freelancers create GST-compliant invoices, track payments, automate recurring billing, and grow revenue — all from a beautiful, modern dashboard.

typography.guidelines: Never use Inter for headings. Use Plus Jakarta Sans font with tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em) and IBM Plex Mono or JetBrains Mono for invoice numbers (e.g., INV-2026-0891), amounts (₹1,49,500), and GSTIN identifiers.

color_system.archetype: Grounded Indian FinTech Craft — Deep Obsidian, Indigo Sapphire & Emerald Settlement
rules: Never use pure black #000000 or pure gray #808080. Always tint dark backgrounds with cool slate or deep indigo (#090D16 / #0F172A).
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, modals, or sheets. Always combine backdrop-blur with opaque tint (e.g., bg-white/85 or bg-slate-950/85).
Always explicitly set hover text color on interactive buttons and navigation links.
GST badges and Paid states use Emerald accents with subtle borders (#059669/10% bg, #059669 text).

grid_modes.marketing: Mode A Tetris / Swiss Grid with generous spacing (py-20 to py-28, gap-8 to gap-12)
grid_modes.dashboard: Mode B High Density Grid (gap-4 to gap-6) with strict alignment and matching heights (h-full)

instructions_to_main_agent: CLONE ALL VISIBLE FEATURES & BRANDING FROM BILLNEST TO COLLECTFLOW: Replace 'BillNest' everywhere with 'collectFlow'. Keep the core identity (Indian business invoicing, GST compliance, Razorpay test mode integration, PDF export, customer CRM, analytics).

HYBRID ARCHITECTURE: Build the full marketing public site (Home, Pricing, GST Calculator, FAQ, Contact modal) AND the complete logged-in SaaS billing app (/app, /app/invoices, /app/clients, /app/recurring, /app/reports, /app/settings).

DEMO-READY ZERO CREDENTIALS UX: Provide a 1-click 'Demo Quick Login' on /login so evaluators can instantly jump into the rich logged-in billing application without registering or needing external OTP servers.

REAL WORKING CALCULATORS: On the landing page and dedicated calculator section, provide an interactive GST Tax Calculator (with 0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28% slabs, CGST/SGST vs IGST split toggle, and payment gateway charge deduction) and live Invoice Builder preview that dynamically recalculates totals.

INVOICE PDF EXPORT / PRINT PREVIEW: Provide a clean, authentic Indian GST Tax Invoice printable template preview with HSN/SAC breakdown, Bank Account details, UPI QR code placeholder, and 'Download / Print' trigger.

NO DEFAULT 'AI SLOP' OR VERCEL TEMPLATE FEEL: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for titles with tight tracking, Instrument Sans for body, JetBrains Mono for monetary values and invoice codes. Apply crystal glassmorphism for navbars and tactile subtle borders for cards.

LOCAL STATE PERSISTENCE: Preload the application with realistic Indian corporate seed data in localStorage so creating, editing, and deleting invoices/clients behaves seamlessly and persists across page reloads.
EVERY INTERACTIVE ELEMENT MUST HAVE data-testid attributes matching the testing protocol specs.
